endorsements.quote: Radiologists must have the ability to review, edit, and override AI-generated triage decisions, clinical recommendations, or workflow proposals easily and transparently.
Radiologists must maintain ultimate oversight and decision-making authority, but institutions will need clear policies defining the acceptable boundaries of AI-initiated actions.
Systems must be designed to support human-AI collaboration, not replace expert clinical judgment.

unlisted_practices: Ensure new AI integrations with RIS, PACS, and EHR platforms maintain cybersecurity, comply with data privacy regulations, and do not add unnecessary steps to clinical processes.
Prioritize safety, explainability, and clinician control in early deployments of agentic AI.
Validate agentic AI through prospective, multi-institutional trials demonstrating real-world benefit and safety before broad deployment, and regard it as investigational until then.
Invest in IT infrastructure, user training, ongoing monitoring, and maintenance when adopting agentic AI.

screen.reason: This is a commentary exploring agentic AI in radiology, discussing potential applications, barriers to deployment, and recommendations for clinician-guided implementation.
